items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: That's the time when he had the trio with Doc West and Red Callender, I guess.

ctx.x: talked and laughed and kidded about being up at the honor farm. As if they thought they had done a great, big, magnificent thing, and all they did was just made me develop my friendship with Erroll Garner. Because really, that's the way it was.
That's the time when he had the trio with Doc West and Red Callender, I guess.
Yeah, this is when they were working at the Suzy Q.
